measures.title: Fire and Technology Sales and Use Tax
measures.summary: Would add a one-quarter percent (0.25%) City of Pueblo sales and use tax, raising the city rate from 3.7% to 3.95%. The money would go into a special fund, separate from the General Fund, used only for the Pueblo Fire Department and technology related to public safety, such as fleet, equipment, communications and medical equipment. It is separate from the existing Public Safety Sales Tax for the Police Department.
measures.yesMeans: The city sales and use tax rises by 0.25% to 3.95%, with the money dedicated to the Fire Department and public-safety technology.
measures.noMeans: The city sales tax stays at 3.7% and no dedicated fire and technology fund is created.
